name: copilot-config-sync
description: Sync VS Code AI agent configs (skills, instructions, agents, hooks, prompts, MCP) across machines via a private GitHub Gist.

copilotConfigSync.gistDescription.description: Description used to find/create the sync gist.

copilotConfigSync.gistId.description: Explicit gist ID to sync with. Leave empty to auto-find/create a private gist by description. Set this to share one gist across machines without relying on search.

copilotConfigSync.deviceName.description: Device name recorded in the manifest. Defaults to os.hostname().

copilotConfigSync.changeCheckIntervalSec.description: How often to check for unsynced changes while the panel is visible, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable background checks.

copilotConfigSync.discovery.catalogUrl.description: Online model catalog used to fill in tool calling, vision and context window for discovered models.

copilotConfigSync.discovery.catalogMaxAg.description: Refresh the cached model catalog after this many days.

copilotConfigSync.discovery.defaultConte.description: Context window assumed for a discovered model that neither the endpoint nor the catalog describes.

copilotConfigSync.discovery.defaultMaxOu.description: Max output tokens assumed for a discovered model that neither the endpoint nor the catalog describes.

scripts.test: NODE_PATH=test-mock node --test out/test/crypto.test.js out/test/scanner.test.js out/test/engine.test.js out/test/modelCatalog.test.js out/test/discovery.test.js
